 Bash command
 Generate numbers 1-600 in English words
╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌
 │ cat > /tmp/numwords.sh << 'ENDSCRIPT'
 │ convert_to_words() {
 │   local n=$1
 │   local ones=("" "one" "two" "three" "four" "five" "six" "seven" "eight" "nine")
 │   local teens=("ten" "eleven" "twelve" "thirteen" "fourteen" "fifteen" "sixteen" "seventeen" "eighteen" "nineteen")
 │   local tens=("" "" "twenty" "thirty" "forty" "fifty" "sixty" "seventy" "eighty" "ninety")
 │
 │   if [ $n -lt 10 ]; then
 │     echo "${ones[$n]}"
 │   elif [ $n -lt 20 ]; then
 │     echo "${teens[$((n - 10))]}"
 │   elif [ $n -lt 100 ]; then
 │     local ten=$((n / 10))
 │     local one=$((n % 10))
 │     if [ $one -eq 0 ]; then
 │       echo "${tens[$ten]}"
 │     else
 │       echo "${tens[$ten]} ${ones[$one]}"
 │     fi
 │   else
 │     local hundred=$((n / 100))
 │     local remainder=$((n % 100))
 │     local result="${ones[$hundred]} hundred"
 │     if [ $remainder -gt 0 ]; then
 │       local ten=$((remainder / 10))
 │       local one=$((remainder % 10))
 │       if [ $ten -eq 0 ]; then
 │         result="$result ${ones[$one]}"
 │       elif [ $ten -eq 1 ]; then
 │         result="$result ${teens[$one]}"
 │       else
 │         if [ $one -eq 0 ]; then
 │           result="$result ${tens[$ten]}"
 │         else
 │           result="$result ${tens[$ten]} ${ones[$one]}"
 │         fi
 │       fi
 │     fi
 │     echo "$result"
 │   fi
 │ }
 │
 │ for i in {1..600}; do
 │   convert_to_words $i
 │ done
 │ ENDSCRIPT
 │ bash /tmp/numwords.sh
 │
